ownership_load_trace.scope: One BehavioralChip RF RX/RF TX/wired duplex/RF RX/RF TX fault/recovered RF TX/recovered RF RX sequence drives one LocalLoadTransient using one architecture current inventory and both local/HOST load inputs.
